note: Drift anchor for scripts/check-sbom-drift.mjs. `firstPartyDivergent` lists the accepted set of packages whose own workspace declarations resolve to >1 version; the guard fails when a NEW name appears. `budgets` are ceilings on the dependency shape; the guard fails when a total exceeds its budget. --update-baseline only lowers budgets. Raising one needs --raise-budget "<reason>", which records the reason in `lastBudgetRaise` for review. Never raise a budget to absorb growth that `pnpm dedupe` or a removal would clear. See docs/architecture/dependency-reduction-routine.md.
